title: 3FIT
tagline: 3FIT - Gym & Health Clubs Subscription Platform Engine based on the Optimism Blockchain for managing Gym and Health Club subscriptions via NFTs.
description:
3FIT - Gym & Health Clubs Subscription Platform Engine based on the Optimism Blockchain for managing Gym and Health Club subscriptions via NFTs.

The inception of Idea behind 3FIT comes from the problem of solving intellectual property protection in the form of subscriptions. The team at 3FIT describes the solution as one stop platform for managing your access to any online or offline service via blockchain.
how_its_made: this project uses the generic blockchain technologies with 2 Smart Contracts written in solidity for managing the state of the entire application and stored on blockchain. The project also contains 2 frontends, one for admin users and one for public users. Each of the frontends are created using NextJs.
